Regulation FD Disclosure. On June 29, 2026, Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release announcing that Moody's Ratings has upgraded the Company's corporate family rating to B1 from B2 and concurrently upgraded the Company's senior secured first lien revolving credit facility and senior secured first lien term loan to B1 from B2. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and incorporated herein by reference. The information furnished under this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
